sentences.en: She went to bed, having set the alarm for seven.
sentences.zh: 她上床睡觉前设定了七点的闹钟。

sentences.en: Don't go onto the crossing when the alarm is ringing.
sentences.zh: 红绿灯报警的时候别过马路。

sentences.en: I have three alarm clocks so as not to oversleep.
sentences.zh: 为了不睡过头，我准备了三个闹钟。

senses.zh: 警钟, 警报器, 闹钟 - 警报 - 惊恐, 忧虑

mnemonic: 联想记忆：al+arm（武器）→受了惊吓，拿起武器→惊恐
